title: DataOps
text:
Objective

Transform data into a strategic banking asset

Eliminate data silos and enable integrated decision-making

Build a scalable, governed, and AI-ready organization ## The Core Problem: Data Silos {.smaller}
Fragmented systems across:

Core banking

CRM

Risk

Marketing

Other Sources

Consequences:

Inconsistent KPIs

Slow decision-making

Poor customer experience

Limited AI capability
Missing Single Source of Truth ## Data Silos in Banking {.smaller} ##Linkedin
